_note: Rows the v1 → v2 migration deliberately does NOT carry, because a human decided
they are not real records. This file is the decision, versioned beside the schema,
so a migration run a year from now makes the same one and can say who made it.
It is data, not code, for one reason: the answer comes from the academy, not from
anything the software can work out. Nothing here is a heuristic — each entry names
Excluding a person cascades to their applications. It will NOT cascade to money:
the transform refuses the whole run if an excluded person holds a payment, because
a migration that quietly drops a real transaction is not one you can reconcile.
Every exclusion is written into the v2 audit log at load time, so the database
explains its own gaps instead of leaving somebody to notice a missing applicant.
